summary_1line: Malyavan counsels Ravana to return Sita and make peace with Rama, warning that unrighteousness and ominous signs foretell the destruction of the titans.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Ravana’s hall, the aged titan Malyavan stands before the throne warning the ten‑headed king as anxious ministers look on.
Dark clouds over Lanka rain hot blood while jackals and vultures gather in the city squares beneath a dim sky.
Ravana pauses amid the sound of drums and trumpets, reflecting as the distant roar of the monkey army shakes the earth.
